items.text: Very good game if you like immersive sims, and space. If you get it at the moment, consider opting in to the beta branch - a new major update (ship combat!) is coming out on the 21/04/2026 and saves made on the current version won't be compatible. I'm sure the test brach will be a bit buggy, but the other option is lose you save in a couple weeks, or postphone buying the game until then.
items.text_zh: 如果你喜欢沉浸式模拟游戏和太空，这是款非常好的游戏。如果你现在入手，考虑加入测试分支——一个重大更新（飞船战斗！）将于2026年4月21日推出，而在当前版本上做的存档将不兼容。我确信测试分支会有点bug，但另一个选择是几周后失去你的存档，或者推迟到那时再买这款游戏。

observations.evidence: I'm sure the test brach will be a bit buggy
observations.evidence_zh: 我敢肯定测试分支会有点小毛病
